state.description: Map of state field name -> StateFieldSpec. Compiled to a TypedDict (NOT pydantic).

global_middleware.description: Prepended to every agent node's stack at compile time.

on_error.description: Graceful fallback when the run errors: send this message instead of failing silently, and optionally open a human handoff.

x-ui.help: Customer-facing fallback reply when the workflow errors.
Also open a human-handoff queue item on error.

reducer.description: add_messages for messages; add for accumulating lists; last for overwrite; merge for dict.

type.description: Must exist in the Node Type Registry.

config.description: Validated against the node type's own schema (Section 3).

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema of the node's PRIMARY output value (the value written to its output_key, or structured_response for structured llm/agent). Powers builder {{...}} autocomplete + mapping validation, and (WS8) runtime output validation.

output_schema_strict.description: WS8: when true, a primary-output value that violates output_schema RAISES at runtime (composes with error_handling.on_error); otherwise the mismatch is observed (logged + a nodes.output_schema_mismatch metric) and the run continues.

input_schema.description: WS8: optional JSON Schema of what this node expects to consume (as declared state keys). Drives the build-time producer→consumer contract check AND, when set, runtime input validation before the node runs.

input_schema_strict.description: WS8: when true, incoming state that violates input_schema RAISES before the node runs (composes with error_handling.on_error); otherwise the mismatch is observed (logged + a nodes.input_schema_mismatch metric) and the node still runs.

condition.description: If present, becomes a conditional edge.

mappings.description: WS8: field-level data mapping applied AFTER the source node runs. Each entry copies `from` (a JMESPath over the source node's output value + the current run state) into the state key `to`. `to` MUST be a declared state field. Applies only to plain data edges (ignored on router/branches/subagent edges).

from.description: JMESPath evaluated over {..state, ..node_output, "output": node_output}. e.g. 'output.items[0].id' or 'tool_result.data'.

to.description: Target state key to write (must be declared in the workflow State).
